title: Add habit offers a choice of habit type
preconditions: App installed and started; intro skipped so the Habits list is shown.
step: Tap «Add habit».
expected: A dialog opens with two options: «Yes or No» and «Measurable».

step: Read the text under «Yes or No».
expected: The text is «e.g. Did you wake up early today? Did you exercise? Did you play chess?»

step: Read the text under «Measurable».
expected: The text is «e.g. How many miles did you run today? How many pages did you read?»

title: Measurable form shows all its fields
step: Tap «Add habit», then tap «Measurable».
expected: The Create habit form opens.

step: Look at the form from top to bottom (scroll if needed).
expected: These fields are shown: «Name», «Question», «Unit», «Target», «Frequency», «Target Type», «Reminder», «Notes». A Color button is also shown.

step: Look at the top of the form.
expected: The buttons «Navigate up» and «SAVE» are shown.

title: Measurable form hints
preconditions: Habits list is shown. The Create habit (Measurable) form is open and all fields are empty.
step: Read the hint in the empty «Name» field.
expected: «Name» shows «e.g. Run»

step: Read the hint in the empty «Question» field.
expected: «Question» shows «e.g. How many miles did you run today?»

step: Read the hint in the empty «Unit» field.
expected: «Unit» shows «e.g. miles»

step: Read the hint in the «Target» field.
expected: «Target» shows «e.g. 15»

step: Read the hint in the «Notes» field.
expected: «Notes» shows «(Optional)»

title: Target Type default and options
preconditions: Habits list is shown. The Create habit (Measurable) form is open.
step: Read the value of «Target Type» without changing it.
expected: The value is «At least».

step: Tap «Target Type».
expected: A picker opens with the options «At least» and «At most». No third option is listed.

step: Choose «At most».
expected: «Target Type» now shows «At most».

title: Frequency starts at Every day
step: Tap «Add habit», then tap «Measurable».
expected: The Create habit form opens.

step: Read the value of «Frequency».
expected: The value is «Every day».

title: Empty Target is refused on the measurable form
preconditions: Habits list is shown. The Create habit (Measurable) form is open and all fields are empty.
step: Tap «SAVE».
expected: The form stays open; the Habits list is not shown. An error icon is shown on the «Target» field.

step: Tap the «Target» field.
expected: A popup on the field shows «Cannot be blank».

title: Save a measurable habit
preconditions: Habits list is shown. No habit named «reconqa Run» exists yet (or use another unique name with the prefix reconqa).
step: Tap «Add habit», then tap «Measurable».
expected: The Create habit form opens.

step: Enter `reconqa Run` in «Name», `miles` in «Unit» and `5` in «Target».
expected: The values are shown in the fields.

step: Tap «SAVE».
expected: The app returns to the Habits list. A habit named `reconqa Run` is shown in the list.

title: Measurable habit saves with an empty Question
preconditions: Habits list is shown. The Create habit (Measurable) form is open.
step: Enter `reconqa Pages` in «Name», `pages` in «Unit» and `10` in «Target». Leave «Question» empty.
expected: The values are shown; «Question» shows «e.g. How many miles did you run today?».

step: Tap «SAVE».
expected: The app returns to the Habits list. A habit named `reconqa Pages` is shown. No error is shown.

title: Empty Name on the Yes or No form
step: Tap «Add habit», then tap «Yes or No».
expected: The Create habit form opens.

step: Leave «Name» empty and tap «SAVE».
expected: The form stays open. An error icon is shown on the «Name» field.

step: Tap the «Name» field.
expected: A popup under the field shows «Cannot be blank».

title: Color button has an accessible label
preconditions: TalkBack is on. The Create habit (Measurable) form is open.
step: Move the TalkBack focus to the Color button (right of «Name»).
expected: TalkBack reads a spoken label for the button (inferred: the atlas only shows that no label is exposed).

title: Habit row controls have accessible labels
preconditions: TalkBack is on. The habit `reconqa Run` exists (see TC-MEAS-007) and the Habits list is shown.
step: Move the TalkBack focus through the controls in the `reconqa Run` row, one at a time.
expected: Each of the 5 clickable controls in the row reads a spoken label (inferred: the atlas only shows that no label is exposed).
